summary: Hesai Group filed a Form 6-K announcing an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) scheduled for August 28, 2026, to consider resolutions detailed in the accompanying circular. The board fully supports the proposed resolutions and recommends shareholders vote in favor. Record date for ordinary shares is July 23, 2026 (Hong Kong time) and for ADS holders July 23, 2026 (New York time). The filing also references continuing connected transactions with Sharpa, including a revised annual cap under a supply agreement. This is a routine corporate governance/E GM notice, not a special situation; no transactional terms or strategic event are disclosed.
